fact: 至迟在1907年，西门子-舒克特工程公司（Siemens-Schuckertwerke）已完成位于驹桥（Komahashi）桂川（Katsuragawa）河上的日本最大水力发电站建设，向东京供电；西门子东京事务所自1887年设立，与古河系（Furukawa & Co.）的商业往来可追溯至1880年代，外资工程技术与本地财阀渠道的结合已是日本电力化的成熟模式。

sources.title: Siemens, 175 Years of Siemens (official company history PDF, English edition)
sources.quote: The Siemens-Schuckert Denki Kabushiki Kaisha commercial office in Tokyo traced its origins to the first Siemens office on the continent, opened in 1887. And as early as 1907, Siemens-Schuckertwerke had handled construction of the country’s largest hydroelectric plant, on the Katsuragawa River in Komahashi, which supplied power to Tokyo. Now the business connections with Furukawa & Co., which dated back to the 1880s, really paid off.

fact: 日本财阀（zaibatsu，“金融寡头”）在19世纪末至20世纪初逐步演化为以中央控股公司联结的多元化产业集团：至1910年代已捆绑银行与保险、贸易会社、矿业、纺织、钢铁与机械制造，通过将旧产业利润导入新行业（如电机制造）在金融、贸易与制造上实现规模经济。

sources.title: EH.net Encyclopedia — Japanese Industrialization and Economic Growth (Carl Mosk, University of Victoria)
sources.quote: The formation of the zaibatsu (“financial cliques”), which gradually evolved into diversified industrial combines tied together through central holding companies, is a case in point. By the 1910s these had evolved into highly diversified combines, binding together enterprises in banking and insurance, trading companies, mining concerns, textiles, iron and steel plants, and machinery manufactures. By channeling profits from older industries into new lines of activity like electrical machinery manufacturing, the zaibatsu form of organization generated scale economies in finance, trade and manufacturing, drastically reducing information-gathering and transactions costs.

fact: 日本银行（中央银行）依据1882年6月颁布的《日本银行条例》设立，资本金1000万日元，获30年营业许可，1882年10月10日开始营业；此后资本于1887年增至2000万日元、1895年增至3000万日元，1896年总行迁入现址新楼。1907年时日本银行制度已是金本位下（1897年币制改革后）的成熟中枢。

sources.title: Bank of Japan — Outline of the Bank: History (official)
sources.quote: 1882 June The Bank of Japan Act of 1882 is promulgated; the Bank is to have capital of 10 million yen and is given a license to operate for 30 years from the start of business. Oct. 10 Business operation begins. 1887 Mar. An increase in the Bank’s capital is announced from 10 million yen to 20 million yen. ... 1895 Aug. An increase in the Bank’s capital is announced from 20 million yen to 30 million yen. 1896 Apr. The Head Office is moved to a new building at the present location.

fact: 明治政府以“富国强兵”为纲，由文部省推广义务教育与工程技术精英教育，由财政省创建中央银行，形成了中央政府协调基础设施、私人部门主导制造业投资的增长体制；国内储蓄的持续上升支撑了资本积累，日本增长是投资驱动而非出口驱动。

sources.title: EH.net Encyclopedia — Japanese Industrialization and Economic Growth (Carl Mosk, University of Victoria)
sources.quote: Investment-led growth Domestic investment in industry and infrastructure was the driving force behind growth in Japanese output. Both private and public sectors invested in infrastructure, national and local governments serving as coordinating agents for infrastructure build-up. Investment in manufacturing capacity was largely left to the private sector. Rising domestic savings made increasing capital accumulation possible. Japanese growth was investment-led, not export-led. ... fact: 日本银行的30年营业许可在制度上保持连续：1882年获得的30年许可于1910年2月获准再延续30年（自10月10日起算）。1907年的穿越者据此可判断中央银行特许权在可预见期内稳定，货币制度不存在即时的特许中断风险。

fact: 日本工业化的规模经济机制：规模经济来自地理集中、国民经济整体增长以及单个企业产出的扩大；企业沿“学习曲线”下行，随着累计产出上升与需求扩张而降低单位成本。1907年前后的扩张企业即处在这一降本通道中。

sources.title: EH.net Encyclopedia — Japanese Industrialization and Economic Growth (Carl Mosk, University of Victoria)
sources.quote: Scale economies existed due to geographic concentration, to growth of the national economy, and to growth in the output of individual companies. In addition, companies moved down the “learning curve,” reducing unit costs as their cumulative output rose and demand for their product soared.

fact: 劳动力市场的双元化在1910年代成形：小企业、轻工业与农业工资偏低，重工业大企业提供更优报酬并以公司住宅、福利项目等方式覆盖“内部劳动力市场”；资本密集部门高工资、劳动密集部门低工资的分割，加深了收入不平等与社会紧张。1907年的求职者已在向这一结构过渡的前夜。

sources.title: EH.net Encyclopedia — Japanese Industrialization and Economic Growth (Carl Mosk, University of Victoria)
sources.quote: A dualistic economy emerged during the 1910s. Small firms, light industry and agriculture offered relatively low wages. Large enterprises in the heavy industries offered much more favorable remuneration, extending paternalistic benefits like company housing and company welfare programs to their “internal labor markets.”

fact: 前工业基础：日本农业生产力足以在工业化之前支撑大量的乡村与城市手工业（原始工业化）生产；桑树种植支撑养蚕、棉花与茶叶等经济作物在农村扩散，为生丝出口与纺织工业化提供了原料与劳动力底盘。

sources.title: EH.net Encyclopedia — Japanese Industrialization and Economic Growth (Carl Mosk, University of Victoria)
sources.quote: The proto-industrial base Japan's agricultural productivity was high enough to sustain substantial craft (proto-industrial) production in both rural and urban areas of the country prior to industrialization.

fact: 明治政府废除德川时代的联邦式体制，建成以强势中央省部将权力集中于首都东京的单一国家：文部省推行义务教育与工科精英教育，财政省创建日本银行。1907年的身份、教育与营业许可均处于这一中央集权行政框架之下。

sources.title: EH.net Encyclopedia — Japanese Industrialization and Economic Growth (Carl Mosk, University of Victoria)
sources.quote: Jettisoning the confederation style government of the Tokugawa era, the new leaders of the new Meiji government fashioned a unitary state with powerful ministries consolidating authority in the capital, Tokyo. The freshly minted Ministry of Education promoted compulsory primary schooling for the masses and elite university education aimed at deepening engineering and scientific knowledge. The Ministry of Finance created the Bank of Japan
